'''Iván Gutman''' (born 2nd. September 1947) is a Serbian [[chemist]] and [[mathematician]].

==Life and work==
Gutman was born in [[Sombor]], [[Yugoslavia]], in a [[Bunjevci|Bunjevac]] family.<ref name="Encyclopedia HAD, bio"/> In 1970 he graduated [[chemistry]] from the [[University of Belgrade]] where he worked a short time as an assistant at the chemistry department. From 1971 until 1976 he worked as research assistant and senior research assistant at [[Ruđer Bošković Institute]] in [[Zagreb]], department of physical chemistry.
In 1973 he received [[Master of Science|M.Sc.]] degree from the [[University of Zagreb]], in the area of theoretical [[organic chemistry]]. In the same year he received a doctorate degree in [[chemistry]] from the [[University of Zagreb]]. His supervisor was [[Nenad Trinajstić]]. From 1977 he worked at the [[University of Kragujevac]], eventually becoming a full research professor in 1982. In 1981 he received a doctorate degree in mathematics from the [[University of Belgrade]]. From 2012 he is a professor emeritus at the [[University of Kragujevac]].<ref name="Ivan Gutman, bio"/>

His research interests are theoretical [[organic chemistry]], [[physical chemistry]], [[mathematical chemistry]], [[graph theory]], [[spectral graph theory]] and [[discrete mathematics]]. Gutman is known for his work in [[chemical graph theory]] and [[topological index|topological descriptors]]. In [[mathematics]] he introduced the notion of [[graph energy]], a concept originating from [[theoretical chemistry]].<ref>{{cite journal| author=I. Gutman | title=The energy of graph | journal=10. Steirmarkisches Mathematisches Symposium (Stif Rein, Graz, 1978) | year=1978 | volume=103 | pages=1–22}}</ref><ref>{{ cite book | author=I. Gutman | title=Algebraic Combinatorics and Applications | chapter=The Energy of a Graph: Old and New Results | year=2001 | pages=196–211 |doi=10.1007/978-3-642-59448-9_13| isbn=978-3-540-41110-9 }}</ref> With [[Chris Godsil]] he worked on the theory of the [[matching polynomial]].<ref>{{cite journal|author1=C. D. Godsil |author2=I. Gutman | title=On the theory of the matching polynomial | journal=[[Journal of Graph Theory]] | year=1981 | volume=5 | issue=2 | pages=137–144 | doi=10.1002/jgt.3190050203}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|author1=C. D. Godsil |author2=I. Gutman  | chapter=On the matching polynomial of a graph | title=Algebraic Methods in Graph Theory, Vol. I, II (Szeged, 1978) |publisher=North–Holland |location=Amsterdam–New York  | year=1981 | pages=241–249}}</ref>

He is a full member of the [[Serbian Academy of Arts and Sciences]] since 1997. Other memberships include membership in the [[International Academy of Mathematical Chemistry]], the Academy of Nonlinear Sciences (Moscow) and [[Academia Europaea]].<ref name="Acad"/> Gutman is a collaborator on the Lexicon of Danube Croats for Croatian Academic Society 'HAD' in [[Subotica]].<ref name="Lex"/> He was elected a fellow of the International Core Academy of Sciences and Humanities.
